user.title: Menstrual Cycle Companion
user.description: Create a private profile for menstrual cycle tracking.

error.invalid_profile: Profile must contain letters or numbers.

add_cycle_start.name: Add cycle start day
add_cycle_start.description: Add one confirmed bleeding day in YYYY-MM-DD format.

remove_cycle_start.name: Remove cycle start day
remove_cycle_start.description: Remove one confirmed bleeding day in YYYY-MM-DD format.

set_cycle_range.name: Set cycle start and end dates
set_cycle_range.description: Add every confirmed bleeding day from the start date through the end date, inclusive.

set_cycle_history.name: Replace full cycle history
set_cycle_history.description: Replace complete confirmed bleeding history with a list of dates.

set_period_duration.name: Set period duration days
set_period_duration.description: Set forecasted period duration (used for card markers).

erase_all_history.name: Erase all cycle history
erase_all_history.description: Destructive action. Deletes the complete stored history.

export_history.name: Export cycle history
export_history.description: Export the current history to a local file.

refresh_cycle_model.name: Refresh cycle model
refresh_cycle_model.description: Recalculate all date-based sensor values, including days until next predicted start.
